task_title: MCP data plane: declared-table CRUD, table declaration, keyword search and read-only SQL over the same implementations the CLI and HTTP routes call
task_criteria: Each new MCP tool (tables_declare, table_list, table_insert, table_select, table_update, table_delete, search, query) calls the SAME implementation the CLI and HTTP routes call (src/tables/operations.ts, src/tables/declare.ts, src/duckdb/query-surface.ts, the keyword-search core) and accepts a namespace; an undeclared table is refused with the same error text and code the HTTP layer returns (Table '<t>' not found in namespace '<ns>' / NOT_FOUND).

Proven from a real MCP client over BOTH stdio and /mcp on a scratch daemon: declare a table, insert two rows, select one with a filter, update it, delete it, keyword-search a memory and run one SELECT; transcript recorded in docs/evidence/surface-mcp-data-001-2026-11-05.md via scripts/proofs/surface-mcp-data-001.mjs.

Grants bite on the MCP path: a token lacking table write is refused by table_insert with reason table_grant and the denial lands in the namespace audit ledger with op tables.write and reason table_grant, matching what requireTableGrant produces on REST; the same token can still read the table.
test-counts.json is bumped in the same commit as the new suite and the full unit suite is green.

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Each new MCP tool (tables_declare, table_list, table_insert, table_select, table_update, table_delete, search, query) calls the SAME implementation the CLI and HTTP routes call (src/tables/operations.ts, src/tables/declare.ts, src/duckdb/query-surface.ts, the keyword-search core) and accepts a namespace; an undeclared table is refused with the same error text and code the HTTP layer returns (Table '<t>' not found in namespace '<ns>' / NOT_FOUND).: src/mcp/tools/tables.ts:36-45 imports insertTableRows/selectTableRows/updateTableRows/deleteTableRows/listNamespaceTables/resolveTableDeclaration/filterParams from src/tables/operations.ts, declareTable from src/tables/declare.ts, runReadOnlyQuery from src/duckdb/query-surface.ts; src/http/routes/tables.ts:77-83 imports the identical set (REST handlers reduced to thin adapters, e.g. :703 insertTableRows, :624 selectTableRows, :738 updateTableRows, :765 deleteTableRows); src/cli/tables.ts:29,243 calls declareTable. search tool src/mcp/tools/search.ts:17,121 calls keywordSearch (the CLI search core). Every tool takes NamespaceArg (tables.ts:129-132) resolved via resolveNamespaceName. NOT_FOUND text originates once in src/tables/operations.ts:114-124 (`Table '<t>' not found in namespace '<ns>'` / NOT_FOUND) and is surfaced verbatim by refusalFromError (tables.ts:76-84). Test src/mcp/tools/tables-surface.test.ts:148-159 asserts the exact text and code; suite run: 7 passed (7).
  ✓ Proven from a real MCP client over BOTH stdio and /mcp on a scratch daemon: declare a table, insert two rows, select one with a filter, update it, delete it, keyword-search a memory and run one SELECT; transcript recorded in docs/evidence/surface-mcp-data-001-2026-11-05.md via scripts/proofs/surface-mcp-data-001.mjs.: scripts/proofs/surface-mcp-data-001.mjs uses the real @modelcontextprotocol/sdk Client with StdioClientTransport and StreamableHTTPClientTransport against a scratch daemon (port 28734, scratch DUCKBRAIN_NAMESPACES_PATH, apikey file with proof-admin/proof-reader). docs/evidence/surface-mcp-data-001-2026-11-05.md records both transcripts: [1] stdio — tables_declare widgets, table_insert inserted:2, table_select qty=gte.6 order=id.asc count:1, table_update pk=2 updated:1, table_delete pk=1 deleted:1, undeclared-table NOT_FOUND; [2] POST /mcp — tables_declare http_items, insert 2, update, select, delete, search returning the 'zebra' memory (count:1), and query SELECT count(*) AS n FROM memories (rows [{n:1}]). A REST parity block on the same daemon is also included.
  ✓ Grants bite on the MCP path: a token lacking table write is refused by table_insert with reason table_grant and the denial lands in the namespace audit ledger with op tables.write and reason table_grant, matching what requireTableGrant produces on REST; the same token can still read the table.: src/mcp/tools/tables.ts:96-127 authorizeTableVerb calls authorizeTableAccess (src/auth/roles.ts:150-183) — the exact function requireTableGrant calls (src/auth/middleware.ts:358-384) — and on denial calls auditTableGrantDenial (src/mcp/tools/shared.ts) emitting op `tables.${op}` (= tables.write), outcome 'denied', reason table_grant; the refusal returns code FORBIDDEN + reason table_grant + decision.message, matching REST's res.status(403).json({error: decision.message, code:'FORBIDDEN'}). Test tables-surface.test.ts:176-229 asserts reason 'table_grant', error `Forbidden: principal 'mcp-reader' has no write grant for table 'widgets'`, audit row {op:'tables.write', reason:'table_grant'}, and that the same token still succeeds on table_select. Live proof in the evidence doc: denial rows [{"op":"tables.write","table":"widgets","principal":"proof-reader","reason":"table_grant"}] plus 'table_select with read-only table grant: success:true'.
  ✓ test-counts.json is bumped in the same commit as the new suite and the full unit suite is green.: git show HEAD -- test-counts.json shows suites 257->258 and tests 2141->2148 inside commit 1c2e3f0f, the same commit that adds src/mcp/tools/tables-surface.test.ts. Fresh full run of the configured command (`npx vitest run --reporter=dot`) exited 0 with 'Test Files 258 passed (258)' and 'Tests 2148 passed (2148)', 0 FAIL lines, Duration 80.97s — exactly matching test-counts.json. The new suite alone: 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 7 passed (7)'.
All four criteria verified: MCP data-plane tools are thin adapters over the same operations/declare/query-surface/keyword-search cores the CLI and REST use, with identical NOT_FOUND and table_grant refusal semantics; both-transport live proof is recorded; and the full suite is green at 258 files / 2148 tests matching the bumped test-counts.json in the same commit.
